description: This file defines styling functions for Navbar components in a React project using Material UI. It exports style functions for navbar layout, container, row, icon button, and mobile menu.

methods.name: navbar
methods.description: Generates style object for the navbar component based on theme and ownerState.

methods.name: navbarContainer
methods.description: Returns style object for the navbar container layout.

methods.name: navbarRow
methods.description: Returns style object for the navbar row layout, responsive to 'isMini' and breakpoints.

methods.name: navbarIconButton
methods.description: Returns style object for icon button in the navbar, responsive to breakpoints.

methods.name: navbarMobileMenu
methods.description: Returns style object for mobile menu display, responsive to breakpoints.
